overall_reason: Executed evidence (50 TLC evaluations of the real base/Proposed definitions on states mapped from Go runs of both trees) confirms the initial plan with one revision. AutoLeaveAdvance must be modified: the old property required the duplicate leave the update fixes (AL-dup-old), accepted the now-forbidden DropQuota retry (AL-quota-old) and the missing pendingConf bump (AL-nobump-old), and accepted a duplicate the new code still produces under early Advance (AL-early-dup-new). ProposalConfigurationDecisions and OutcomeSoundness are modified for the joint admission rule, the observer migration and the s>0 quota relaxation; the admission contract was revised so it no longer forbids an allowed admission (PCinit-nonjoint-empty-explicit-old). LeaderTransferTarget is added for demoted transferees. All other properties are kept; keep checks on new-code states pass and unaffected controls keep identical verdicts. Four bug candidates in the new code are recorded and NOT hidden: BC1, BC2a, BC2b, BC3.

entries.change_reason: The initial deterministic contract (non-joint arm: admit iff changes#<<>>) rejected the old code's admission of a valid no-op enter-joint (empty changes, JointExplicit) in a non-joint config (PCinit-nonjoint-empty-explicit-old: initial FALSE). That behaviour is allowed (joint_safety.txt:24-27 shows it is a valid transition; node.go:136-139 also permits dropping), and the new code does not produce it, so the strengthening was not justified. The final contract makes that single case an optional drop; nearby forbidden controls (PC4, PC5-nonjoint-leave-old) are still rejected.

Old code left the joint config here.

Early Advance (permitted by README.md:122 and node.go:164-167) over the joint entry before ApplyConfChange: the crossing is consumed while the config is not yet joint, so the auto-leave is never issued. Old code left on the next Advance.
